basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old amateur mechanic from Springfield, Illinois. By day, I work as an IT support specialist, but I love tinkering with cars in my spare time. My fascination with mechanics began when I inherited my granddad's old Ford, which I've been slowly restoring. I'm single and enjoy spending weekends at local car meets or exploring outdoor shooting ranges. I often browse Reddit in the evenings after work, usually around 7-10 PM CST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've always been a hands-on learner, fixing minor issues on my own vehicles and learning through trial and error. My knowledge is mostly self-taught through YouTube videos, forums, and occasionally seeking advice from more experienced mechanics online.
